Comprehensive Supports for Improvement - Any Title I school with Level 1 in at least half of the rated indicators and any high school with a four-year graduation rate below 67%.

Targeted Supports for Improvement - Any school with a specific group of students with a Level 1 in at least half of the rated indicators, which include the four-year graduation rate and five-year completer rate.

Classrooms less than 800 SF have a student capacity of 24; classrooms greater than 800 SF and less than 1,000 SF have a student capacity of 27; classrooms greater than 1,000 SF have a student capacity of 30.

Gross capacity * utilization rate (see below). Functional capacity is a practical estimate of students a school site accommodates. It is not the maximum occupancy per building code requirements nor is it meant to be used as a staffing determinant. Staffing will be determined by programmatic need.

A factor applied to a school building based on its configuration (K-5, K-8, MS, HS) that approximates what percentage of a school day instructional spaces are used (see below). Utilization rate lowered by 5% for Title I schools.
